name: fit-six-lobes
why: A six-lobed closed fit at 0.05 mm, extruded 10: 13131.858 mm3 in closed form, the mesh a chord short. Fitted on chord-length parameters it took 131 poles for a 0.042 mm deviation; the periodic fit with corrected parameters holds 0.05 on 49 poles (held by a kernel test in skinned.rs; the deviation is recorded here). The volume is within 0.05 mm times the 198.7 mm perimeter times 10 (99 mm3) of the closed form.
